_comment: TOOL is code and documentation. FIXTURE is generated synthetic test/example material. DATA is real-run input, prompts, transcripts and results in a verified PRIVATE versioned companion; never in the public tool repo.
_audited: 2026-09-23: fleet status and acceptance inputs/results are DATA. The fleet writer uses the shared resolver and verifies private versioned storage, including explicit output paths. The acceptance gate reads external evaluator evidence and prints its result without writing into the tool repository. Test bundles are generated by tools/make_fixtures.py in temporary directories; the public report example is generated reproducibly by the same tool.
_data_home: Verified PRIVATE skill-smith-config companion via SKILL_SMITH_CONFIG or SKILL_SMITH_DATA_DIR; no in-repo fallback.
